name: Hắc Phong Twin Hooks (Hắc Phong Song Câu)
story: The chief of Hắc Phong carried both. Since 940 one has been in the south with the daughter who got away and one in the Pivot's service with the son who was taken. The pair is whole only if the two meet, and one of them gives up a blade.

name: Miasma Walker (Chướng Hành Tam Vật)

bonuses.effect: Walked Out of Chiết Kích (Xuất Chiết Kích)
bonuses.rule: each poison or curse stack that lands on you thickens your ward by 2 % of your health instead of its harm, and the ward loses a twentieth of itself each second; while that ward holds, your escape channel is a third shorter.

story: A goat's bell he came out of the miasma with, and the clay-soaked robe and cellar door he has carried back in since. Quý Thủ Lũy has asked twice what he would leave them to.

name: Stockade Mistress (Thạch Môn Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each hit you take gives you one Thunder buff stack, and the stacks fall away one every 2 s; your next hook strike spends them, striking once more with Thunder for each.

story: What she took from the ridge besides the Black Wind Hook: her mail and the lightning sand. She wears them beside the hook, whose twin is with her brother.

name: The Free Crossing (Nghĩa Độ Song Vật)

bonuses.rule: while you have a companion or are Composed, your ward regains 2 % each second; the first time each fight you would fall below a quarter of your health, the lamp heals you 15 %.

story: His stern lamp, lit since 1174, and the crossing's stone anchor, older than any ferryman there. They will pass with the boat.

name: Night Rain Stall (Dạ Vũ Song Vật)

bonuses.effect: Leave While It Burns (Phần Thời Tẩu)
bonuses.rule: when a curse you laid is cleansed or one of your talismans burns out, you cannot be targeted for 1 s (once every 6 s).

story: The false seal he carved the winter he was turned out of Nam Phố, and the robe of wrong maps he lined at Thu Trì.
